description: Permanent memorial static display at Muniz ANGB; described as a non-flyable airframe set aside as a memorial and recorded as having survived the 11 January 1981 Macheteros bomb attack that destroyed eight PRANG A-7D Corsair IIs on the same ramp; serial from the published F-104 survivors list only and undated; operator_country US because the Puerto Rico Air National Guard is a US component
museum_name: Muniz Air National Guard Base F-104 Memorial -- Carolina
